# ARICT GPA Calculator

> Free, unofficial GPA calculator for the Faculty of Applied Sciences, Rajarata University of Sri Lanka (RUSL). Made by ARICT, the Association of Rajarata Information & Communication Technology. Site: https://gpa.arict.lk

Students pick a department, enter a grade for each course, and see semester, cumulative and overall GPA with the class band. Grades stay in the browser (no sign-in, no server). A PDF report can be downloaded and later uploaded to restore every grade. A next-class planner shows the average GPA the remaining courses need for First Class, Second Upper, Second Lower and Pass, for a BSc (3 years) or BSc Honours (4 years), and suggests a target grade for every remaining course.

## How GPA is calculated (FAS Student Handbook 2022/23)
- GPA = sum(grade point x credits) / sum(credits), truncated to two decimals, not rounded.
- Grade points: A+ 4.0, A 4.0, A- 3.7, B+ 3.3, B 3.0, B- 2.7, C+ 2.3, C 2.0, C- 1.7, D+ 1.3, D 1.0, E 0.0.
- Credits are the second digit of the course code: ICT 1407 = 4 credits.
- Non-GPA courses with zero credits: FDN courses and IDC 1202 Career Development.
- Class bands by minimum GPA: First Class 3.70, Second Class (Upper) 3.30, Second Class (Lower) 3.00, Pass 2.00. Classes also need minimum grades and credits; final GPA uses the best 90 credits (BSc) or 120 credits (BSc Honours).

## Departments covered
Biological Sciences, Chemical Sciences, Computing (Information Technology), Health Promotion, Physical Sciences.

## Pages
- [Home](https://gpa.arict.lk/): what the calculator does, the PDF report, the grading system and the FAQ
- [GPA calculator and planner](https://gpa.arict.lk/calculator): pick a department and degree, enter grades, see every GPA and plan the next class
- [ARICT](https://arict.lk): the student association
- [Past papers](https://papers.arict.lk): past examination papers for the same faculty
